operations.credit_rule_for_next_section: Only concepts with state USABLE may be assumed in S08. PARTIAL, MENTION_ONLY, MISCONCEPTION_RISK and MISSING receive no automatic prerequisite credit.

effective_campaign_state.note_on_counts: Running local counts only. Mandatory global passes may merge recurring root causes, reject false positives or change severity when later dependency evidence is available.

S08_entry_watchlist: S08 is the first roadmap section for files, pathlib, CSV, JSON, encodings and ingestion contracts. S07's mojibake/bytes discussion is only a preview and cannot count as a learned decoding model.
NFC/NFD are USABLE from S07. Code-point-versus-visible-character remains PARTIAL and casefold remains PARTIAL because full-email folding was unsafe.
split/join/replace may support S08 parsing examples, but find/search semantics remain unsafe until repaired; do not rely on truthiness of find results.
Regex fullmatch-vs-search and named groups are USABLE. Raw-string notation and ^/$ anchors remain PARTIAL and should not be assumed without a bridge.
Jaccard token similarity is MISCONCEPTION_RISK: empty evidence receives wrong scores and set semantics discard order/repetition. Do not build S08 deduplication or ER behavior on it.
FP/FN remain PARTIAL because S07 omitted an independent ground-truth/reference-label model.
Personal-name component parsing remains MISCONCEPTION_RISK; S08 must preserve original fields and not treat last-two-token segmentation as canonical truth.
raw/normalized/transforms remains PARTIAL because S07 defined the contract but failed to demonstrate it as one integrated theory artifact. S08 should not claim provenance is already mastered.
Exceptions/raise/try-except remain MENTION_ONLY until S09 unless a deliberate curriculum repair establishes a bounded earlier model.
Module/import mechanics remain MENTION_ONLY until S10. S08 will necessarily use pathlib/csv/json and must microdefine imports rather than assume them.
Email normalization remains MISCONCEPTION_RISK: preserve local-part semantics and do not propagate whole-address casefold into ingestion.
Unicode numeric classes are broader than ASCII digits; any S08 schema or parsing rule that intends 0-9 must say so explicitly.
CP-N1-B/CASO identifiers remain a persistent widow-term family unless expanded globally.
